notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total column of the governmental funds statement (p4): fund balance 376,365 + 377,156 - 384,804 - net transfers out 26,064 = 342,653. The statements roll forward fund balance (equal to cash under this basis); beginning cash is not printed, ending cash is the governmental funds balance sheet cash lines (p3). Disbursements are listed by object; function from the fund (General -> general government) with review; Statement of Activities (p2) shows general government 276,786, public works 23,251 (Street fund excl. debt), public health and safety 13,000. Transfers printed only as a net figure in the Total column; the 26,064 went to the Water (13,463) and Sewer (12,601) funds. Business-type (Water and Sewer, p6), measure net position (modified cash): 330,770 + 124,831 - 149,692 + 26,064 = 331,973; no single total printed, so receipts/disbursements totals are summed from operating and nonoperating lines (the proprietary budget schedule p8 prints 124,830 / 149,691, off by 1 from rounding). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p3, totals equal the government-wide 342,653), business-type lines from the Statement of Net Position (p1); p5 proprietary net position statement agrees. Detail (user rule, cities/villages): the only supplementary schedules are combined budget schedules (p7 governmental, p8 proprietary), so detail is one line per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4) and the proprietary statement (p6); the combined budget schedules are not recorded.
